name: vital-expert
description: Vital.Expert plugins for Cowork. Digital Health packs, vital-trusted (sole Prove/Build/Core pack; optional vvfy_ for live Prove tools), vital-navigator-outcomes (legacy navigator-ai-investment), vital-es-target-evaluation-due-diligence (CF-01.02.06 live-test), vital-mlr-review. The vital-verify plugin was retired 8 November 2026, vital-es-financial-modeling-and-valuation (CF-01.02.02 live-test), and FOCUSED (vital-focused).

plugins.name: vital-trusted
plugins.description: Nineteen foundational skills for daily life-sciences work (Core / Build / Prove). 0.3.4 Pilot. Offline-first; Prove skills check by hand against supplied material (no VERIFY connector or key). The vital-verify plugin remains retired — install this pack only.

plugins.name: vital-navigator-outcomes
plugins.description: Outcome Navigator (CF-01.06.01): investment decisions and measurement — from value-at-stake to value realized. GenAI is a vertical, not the brand. Tools on vont_; optional Curator steward skills (pull/classify/process/decide/enrich) on vcur_. Marketplace v0.3.1-live-test.

plugins.name: vital-es-target-evaluation-due-diligence
plugins.description: Target Evaluation & Due Diligence (CF-01.02.06). Nine skills + ON↔DD use-case packs. Standard KA Pass (v9); Draft 0.1.2-on-dd-e2e for Cowork. Not Marketplace Done. Optional vont_/verify keys; offline script-first.

plugins.name: vital-es-financial-modeling-and-valuation
plugins.description: Financial Modeling & Valuation (CF-01.02.02). Nine skills + valuation summary. Standard KA Pass (v2); Draft 0.1.1-live-test for Cowork. Not Marketplace Done. Ranges only — no fairness/recommend. Optional vont_/verify keys; offline script-first.
